  consider the dissolution of the GAC Subcommittees.

  A motion was made by Member Conkings, seconded by Member Barrett, to
  approve recommendation, as amended, to create the Golf Operations Manual
  Ad Hoc Committee whose members are Member Conkings, Member Barrett
  and Member Ricci, and the Capital Improvement Projects Ad Hoc Committee,
  whose members are Vice Chair Fitzgerald and Member Conkings; and to
  dissolve all the GAC Sub Committees, including the Fees and Charges Sub
  Committee, Policies and Procedures Sub Committee, Capital Improvements
  Sub Committee and Maintenance and Environmental Best Practices
  Committee. The motion carried by the following vote:
